class.name: JRPGStatBlock
class.brief_description: A battler's computed parameters and trait totals.
class.description: Computes a battler's numbers from its base parameters (class curve or enemy values), equipment bonuses, trait sources (actor, class, equipment, states...) and buff levels. A parameter is (base + equipment) multiplied by each of its Param traits, then by the buff factor, then kept within the project's limits. Ex-parameters add their trait values (base 0); sp-parameters multiply them (base 100%). Values are integers; rates are basis points (10000 = 100%). Results are cached until something changes.

method.name: add_buff
method.description: Moves the buff level of [param param] by [param steps] (negative for debuffs), staying within the project's buff limit. A buff and a debuff cancel each other.

method.name: add_trait_source
method.description: Adds a list of trait dictionaries (for example an equipped weapon's traits).

method.name: get_buff_level
method.description: Returns the buff level of [param param].

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns the final value of parameter [param param] (in [enum JRPGClassData.Param] order).

method.name: get_rules
method.description: Returns the battle rules used for buffs and limits.

method.name: get_sparam
method.description: Returns sp-parameter [param sparam] in basis points.

method.name: get_xparam
method.description: Returns ex-parameter [param xparam] in basis points.

method.name: has_trait
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any source has a trait with [param code] and [param data_id].

method.name: set_buff_level
method.description: Sets the buff level of [param param], within the project's buff limit.

method.name: set_equipment_params
method.description: Sets the total flat parameter bonuses of the battler's equipment.

method.name: set_rules
method.description: Sets the battle rules that provide buff size, buff limit and parameter limits.

method.name: set_trait_sources
method.description: Replaces the trait sources with [param sources], an [Array] of trait lists.

method.name: trait_product_bp
method.description: Returns the product of the values of every trait with [param code] and [param data_id], starting at 10000 (100%).

method.name: trait_set
method.description: Returns the sorted, unique data IDs of every trait with [param code].

method.name: trait_sum
method.description: Returns the sum of the values of every trait with [param code] and [param data_id], or with any data ID when [param data_id] is negative.
